mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary regime that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the rank information coefficient over triggered periods is not statistically significant at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) contraction of more than 10% month-over-month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST m/m change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to produce a statistically significant negative alpha in a walk-forward backtest.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% for three consecutive months, in the absence of a corresponding rise in unemployment (UNRATE), signals an expansionary supply-side shock that boosts corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE does not rise by >0.2pp in the same period
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero during triggered periods, or the mechanism produces a negative rank IC over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) acceleration above 0.4% coincident with a consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) year-over-year increase above 3.5% signals tight labor markets with rising inflation, which increases input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS m/m change > 0.4% AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails a walk-forward significance test at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained period (six consecutive months) where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1% indicates an ultra-loose monetary policy environment that supports risk asset valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the rank IC is not robust across multiple out-of-sample splits.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 1% while unemployment (UNRATE) remains below 4% signals demand weakness in a tight labor market, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with weakening demand
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails a significance test in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below -0.3% for four consecutive months, regardless of monetary policy stance, signals a broad-based supply shock that depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not produce a significant negative alpha in short-horizon tests.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) decline of more than 0.4 percentage points while consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 2% indicates a loosening labor market with stable prices, which supports corporate margin expansion and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE m/m change < -0.4pp AND CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%
regime_hint: loosening labor market with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the mechanism fails a walk-forward significance test at the 5% level.
